## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: on the first run after BRIDGE_ENV_ID transitions from unset/empty to set, a one-shot migration BRIDGE_ALERT is emitted documenting that pre-migration events are not retroactively replayed

## What
Write a failing test for the sentinel-gated migration BRIDGE_ALERT: verifies that when bridge_env_id is non-empty and no sentinel file exists at .tickets-tracker/.bridge-env-id-transition-marker, process_events (or a new helper in bridge-outbound.py) emits a BRIDGE_ALERT with a migration reason and creates the sentinel file. Also verifies that subsequent calls (sentinel present) emit no additional BRIDGE_ALERT.

## Test approach
Given: tmp_path as tickets_dir with no .bridge-env-id-transition-marker file, bridge_env_id=\"uuid-1234\" 
When: emit_migration_bridge_alert_if_needed(tickets_dir, bridge_env_id=\"uuid-1234\") is called twice
Then: 
- First call: BRIDGE_ALERT file created in tmp_path with event_type=BRIDGE_ALERT and data.reason containing \"pre_migration\"
- sentinel file .bridge-env-id-transition-marker created in tickets_dir
- Second call: no additional BRIDGE_ALERT file created (sentinel prevents duplicate)

## Implementation
In tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py, add:

def test_migration_bridge_alert_emitted_on_first_env_id_set_and_sentinel_gates_repeat(
    tmp_path: Path, bridge: ModuleType
) -> None:
    \"\"\"emit_migration_bridge_alert_if_needed writes BRIDGE_ALERT on first call
    and is a no-op on subsequent calls when the sentinel file exists.\"\"\"
    bridge_env_id = \"test-uuid-bridge-env\"
    
    # First call: sentinel absent -> BRIDGE_ALERT should be written
    bridge.emit_migration_bridge_alert_if_needed(tmp_path, bridge_env_id)
    alert_files = list(tmp_path.glob(\"*-BRIDGE_ALERT.json\"))
    assert len(alert_files) == 1, \"BRIDGE_ALERT must be written on first transition run\"
    
    import json
    alert_data = json.loads(alert_files[0].read_text())
    assert alert_data.get(\"event_type\") == \"BRIDGE_ALERT\"
    assert \"pre_migration\" in alert_data.get(\"data\", {}).get(\"reason\", \"\"), \\
        \"BRIDGE_ALERT reason must mention pre_migration\"
    
    sentinel = tmp_path / \".bridge-env-id-transition-marker\"
    assert sentinel.exists(), \"Sentinel file must be created on first call\"
    
    # Second call: sentinel present -> no additional BRIDGE_ALERT
    bridge.emit_migration_bridge_alert_if_needed(tmp_path, bridge_env_id)
    alert_files_after = list(tmp_path.glob(\"*-BRIDGE_ALERT.json\"))
    assert len(alert_files_after) == 1, \"No additional BRIDGE_ALERT when sentinel present\"

Update .test-index:
[test_migration_bridge_alert_emitted_on_first_env_id_set_and_sentinel_gates_repeat] for plugins/dso/scripts/bridge-outbound.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test exists in tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
  Verify: grep -q \"test_migration_bridge_alert_emitted_on_first_env_id_set_and_sentinel_gates_repeat\" tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
- [ ] Test FAILS before the implementation (emit_migration_bridge_alert_if_needed does not yet exist)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest \"tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py::test_migration_bridge_alert_emitted_on_first_env_id_set_and_sentinel_gates_repeat\" 2>&1 | grep -q \"FAILED\\|ERROR\\|failed\\|error\"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_migration_bridge_alert_emitted_on_first_env_id_set_and_sentinel_gates_repeat] for plugins/dso/scripts/bridge-outbound.py
  Verify: grep \"\\[test_migration_bridge_alert_emitted_on_first_env_id_set_and_sentinel_gates_repeat\\]\" .test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
